# Financial Times

> The Financial Times provides real-time global news, market data, and analysis on economics, geopolitics, and business across all major regions and sectors.

FT.com is a leading source for financial and business journalism, offering comprehensive coverage of global markets, central banking, geopolitics, and emerging markets. The site combines breaking news with real-time market data and premium subscription content for professional investors and business leaders.

## Key Topics

- Financial Markets
- Central Banks
- Geopolitics
- Emerging Markets
- Energy Markets
- Interest Rates
- Iran Conflict
- Global Trade
- Mergers & Acquisitions
- Artificial Intelligence
- Middle East Conflict
- US Foreign Policy
- Technology Sector
- Digital Access
- Bank of England

## Core Products & Access

- [Home - Financial Times](https://www.ft.com): FT homepage with latest news on markets, economics, politics and geopolitics
- [Subscribe to the Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/products): FT subscription plans: Standard Digital, Premium Digital, newsletters and mobile app
- [Markets data - stock market, bond, equity, commodity prices - FT.com](https://markets.ft.com/data): Real-time market data dashboard with stock indices, bonds, currencies, commodities
- [Accessibility Home](https://www.ft.com/accessibility): FT.com accessibility standards and WCAG 2.2 compliance information

## Global News & Regional Coverage

- [World | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/world): Global news coverage from Europe, Asia, Middle East and Americas
- [US | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/us): US news coverage: economy, politics, White House, Fed policy and trade
- [UK | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/world-uk): UK news hub covering economy, politics, Bank of England, energy and housing
- [Europe | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/europe): Europe news: economy, ECB interest rates, politics, energy and M&A
- [China | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/china): China news hub: economy, politics, tech sector, AI and emerging markets
- [Asia-Pacific | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/asia-pacific): Asia-Pacific news: regional economy, central banking, geopolitics and trade
- [Americas | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/americas): Americas news: economy, politics, M&A, geopolitics and energy
- [Africa | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/africa): Africa news coverage: economy, politics, Nigeria investment and emerging markets

## Economics & Markets

- [Global Economy | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/global-economy): Global economic news: central banks, interest rates, inflation, trade data
- [Emerging markets | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/emerging-markets): Emerging markets news and analysis: geopolitical risks, oil/gas, finance
- [Middle East & North Africa | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/middle-east-north-africa): Middle East & North Africa news: Iran conflict, energy markets, geopolitics

## Geopolitical Analysis

- [War in Ukraine | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/war-in-ukraine): Russia-Ukraine war coverage: military developments, sanctions, economic impact
- [Middle East war | Financial Times](https://www.ft.com/middle-east-war): Latest news and analysis on Middle East conflict, Iran-Israel tensions, Gaza war
